india_invested.summary:
* **CYIENTDLM (CYIENTDLM)** - Closed down 3.13% at ₹946 on September 9 amid an analyst note on share volatility, with an investor meet scheduled for September 11, 2026.
* **EPACKPEB (EPACKPEB)** - Stock price rose approximately 6% to ₹248 on September 9, 2026.
* **LAURUSLABS (LAURUSLABS)** - NCLT hearing scheduled for September 10, 2026, regarding a composite scheme of arrangement involving LSPL and Sriam Labs.
* **PRIVISCL (PRIVISCL)** - Reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.22% YoY to ₹666.22 crore and net profit up 35.97% YoY to ₹84.21 crore.
* **QPOWER (QPOWER)** - Analyst and investor meeting with a plant visit to Winwin Speciality Insulators scheduled for September 11, 2026.
* **SJS (SJS)** - Analyst share price target was updated on September 9, 2026.
* **SANSERA (SANSERA)** - CLSA initiated coverage with an 'Outperform' rating and a target price of ₹4,954, citing strong ADS segment potential.
* **SHREEREF (SHREEREF)** - Share price fell 4.17% to ₹404.45 on September 9, 2026.
* **TANFACIND (TANFACIND)** - Announced the outcome of its Preferential Issue Committee meeting held on September 9, 2026.
* **STLTECH (STLTECH)** - Shares hit a fresh 52-week high of ₹865.90, rising 5% to lock in the upper circuit for the fourth straight session.

us_invested.summary:
* **HIMS (HIMS)** - Faces multiple investor notices regarding an ongoing securities class action stemming from an FTC complaint over deceptive privacy and billing practices.
* **JNJ (JNJ)** - Scheduled to deliver a corporate presentation at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on September 14, 2026.
* **Krystal Biotech (KRYS)** - Scheduled for a fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference today, while C WorldWide Group trimmed its Q2 stake by 14.7%.
* **META (META)** - Rose over 6% following the launch of its "Muse" AI agent, alongside an $18 billion youth safety settlement, an acquisition of Stilla.ai, and a $28.1 million stake purchase by Ark Invest.
* **Oracle (ORCL)** - Reports fiscal Q1 2027 earnings today post-market amid reports of a $638 billion backlog and a $70 billion fiscal 2027 capex plan, while Scotiabank lowered its price target to $215.
* **uniQure (QURE)** - Shares declined 4.4% on September 10 following coverage on MarketBeat TV highlighting the stock for a major catalyst.
* **TWST (TWST)** - BWS Financial initiated coverage on the stock with a Sell rating and a $45 price target.
* **ZS (ZS)** - Highlighted AI security platform demand and ARR growth across investor conferences, while Amundi boosted its position by 12.8%.
* **CYRX (CYRX)** - Wellington Management Group acquired 534,930 shares during the second quarter.
* **ASX (ASX)** - Shares rose approximately 6.08% after posting August 2026 net revenues of NT$82,247 million, up 45.7% year-over-year.
* **RGEN (RGEN)** - Raised full-year organic growth guidance to 10.5%–13.5% at an investor conference and was initiated with a Buy rating and a $225 price target at UBS.
* **AMKR (AMKR)** - Increased its planned Arizona Phase 2 investment to $12 billion and highlighted a $1.5 billion advanced packaging capacity prepayment from NVIDIA.
* **AVGO (AVGO)** - Reported a 221% year-over-year increase in AI semiconductor revenue as CEO Hock Tan cited power site availability as a key infrastructure bottleneck.
* **GEV (GEV)** - Announced that Claire McDonough will succeed Kenneth Parks as Chief Financial Officer, effective January 1, 2027.
* **Arm (ARM)** - Launched its Neoverse Compute Subsystems N4 and AGI CPU for AI applications, while the Xiaomi 18 Fold featuring Arm Mali graphics prepares for sales in China.
* **TransDigm Group (TDG)** - Amundi increased its stake in the company by 8.6% during the second quarter.
